items.question: How long does an ERP implementation take?
items.answer: It depends on scope, modules and how ready your data is. We give a realistic timeline after the Understand and Analyze steps, not before.

items.question: Can you improve an ERP we already own?
items.answer: Yes. Many of our engagements start with an existing system that is under-used, over-customized or poorly integrated.

items.question: Do you build custom software as well as implement ERP?
items.answer: Yes. Our team covers both, so integrations and custom modules are planned together with the ERP, not bolted on later.

items.question: Is Odoo a good fit for a small or mid-size business?
items.answer: Often, yes. Odoo covers accounting, sales, purchasing, inventory, manufacturing and CRM in one system, and it can be introduced one area at a time. We will tell you honestly if your operation is better served by another platform.

items.question: What is the difference between Odoo Community and Odoo Enterprise?
items.answer: Community is the open-source edition with no license fee and covers the core business apps. Enterprise is the licensed edition with additional apps, vendor-hosted options and vendor support. We help you choose based on the features you actually need.

items.question: What does an Odoo project cost?
items.answer: Odoo Community has no license fee, so the cost sits in implementation, customization, hosting and support. We scope these after a short call so you see the full picture before you commit.

items.question: Can Odoo be customized and connected to our other systems?
items.answer: Yes. Odoo can be extended with custom modules and connected to your website, banks, courier services and other software. We keep customizations clean so future upgrades stay manageable.

blocks.heading: Practical help for tasks that eat your team's day
blocks.intro: An AI Agent is software that can take a task, work through the steps and hand back a result. It reads the incoming document or message, checks it against your data, and prepares the next action for a person to approve.

items.title: Handle incoming enquiries
items.description: Answer common questions, collect the missing details and pass qualified requests to the right person.

items.title: Read and check documents
items.description: Pull the key fields from invoices, purchase orders and delivery notes, and flag anything that does not match your records.

items.title: Answer questions about your data
items.description: Ask a plain-language question about stock, sales or receivables and get an answer from your system, with the source shown.

items.title: Prepare reports and summaries
items.description: Draft the weekly numbers, exception lists and management summaries your team now assembles by hand.

items.title: Follow up and remind
items.description: Chase overdue approvals, payments and replies so nothing waits for someone to remember.

items.title: Triage and route work
items.description: Sort requests by type and urgency and send them to the person who should deal with them.

blocks.heading: Start small, prove it, then extend

items.title: Pick one task
items.description: We choose a task that is repetitive, clearly defined and worth the effort.

items.title: Build a pilot
items.description: A working agent on your real data, with a person approving each result.

items.title: Measure
items.description: We compare time, errors and effort before and after, using your numbers.

items.title: Extend
items.description: If it works, we widen its scope. If not, we say so and stop.

items.title: People stay in control
items.description: Agents prepare and suggest. Sensitive actions such as payments, postings and customer commitments wait for human approval.

items.title: Your data stays yours
items.description: We agree where data is processed and stored before the build starts, and we use only what the task needs.

items.title: Built into your systems
items.description: Agents connect to your ERP, email, documents and messaging, instead of sitting in a separate tool nobody opens.

items.title: Honest about limits
items.description: AI makes mistakes. We design checks, logs and fallbacks so errors are caught early and are easy to trace.

items.question: What is an AI Agent?
items.answer: An AI Agent is software that takes a task, works through the steps using your data and tools, and returns a result for a person to review or approve. It is different from a simple chatbot because it can act on information in your systems.

items.question: Will an AI Agent replace my staff?
items.answer: That is not our goal. Agents take over repetitive tasks such as checking, copying and chasing, so your team has time for work that needs judgement. People review the results and make the decisions.

items.question: Is my business data safe?
items.answer: We agree up front which data the agent can see, where it is processed and who can access the results. We use only the data the task needs, and we build access controls and logs into every agent.

items.question: Can an agent work with our ERP?
items.answer: Yes. We connect agents to platforms such as NetSuite, SAP Business One, Odoo and Dynamics 365, as well as email, documents and WhatsApp, depending on what your process uses.

items.question: How do we start?
items.answer: Send a short note about the task that costs you the most time. We will talk it through, tell you honestly whether an agent is the right answer, and propose a small pilot if it is.

blocks.heading: Have a task in mind?
blocks.body: Tell us the job that costs your team the most time. We will tell you honestly if an AI Agent can help.

items.question: What is an in-house MIS?
items.answer: It is a management information system built for your company, often by an internal developer or a small outside team, that runs processes such as sales, stock, production, accounts or HR.

seo.title: Privacy Policy | Entrpryz
seo.description: How Entrpryz collects, uses and protects personal information on entrpryz.com, including the contact form and server logs.

body.text: This website, entrpryz.com, is operated by Javed Ahmad Qureshi, trading as Entrpryz, based in Pakistan ("Entrpryz", "we", "us"). For the purposes of data protection, we are the data controller for the personal information described in this policy.
You can contact us about this policy or your personal information at any time through the contact form on this website.

Information you give us. When you use the contact form we collect your name, email address, company name, area of interest and the message you write. If you contact us through WhatsApp, we receive your phone number, your name as it appears in WhatsApp and the content of your messages.

Information collected automatically. Like most websites, our hosting provider's servers record technical information such as your IP address, browser type, device type, pages visited and the date and time of each request. We do not use analytics or advertising tools.
To reply to your enquiry and discuss work with you.
To keep the website secure and prevent spam and abuse.
To meet legal and accounting obligations, where they apply.
We do not sell your personal information, and we do not use it for automated decisions that significantly affect you.
Where the law requires a legal basis, we rely on our legitimate interest in running a secure website and replying to enquiries, and on taking steps at your request before entering into an agreement.
This website does not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies, so there is no cookie notice to accept or decline.
The only cookie the website sets is one that is strictly necessary for administrators to sign in. Visitors who do not sign in receive no cookies from us.
We share information only with service providers that help us run the website and the business, and only as needed:
Vercel, our web hosting provider, which stores and serves the website and keeps its server logs.
Google (Gmail), our email provider, which delivers the messages you send through the contact form.
Meta Platforms (WhatsApp), if you choose to message us there.
We may also disclose information if the law requires it or to protect our rights.

Some of these providers process information outside Pakistan and the UAE, including in the United States and the European Union. By using the website and the services above, you understand that your information may be processed in those locations under the safeguards each provider offers.

We keep contact form messages and related emails for as long as needed to deal with your enquiry and any resulting work, and generally for no more than 24 months after our last contact unless we are working together or the law requires us to keep them. Server logs are kept for a short period for security.

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to ask for a copy of your personal information, to have it corrected or deleted, to object to or restrict how we use it, to withdraw consent at any time and to complain to a data protection authority.
